children: August was good to U.S. stock investors.

All three major U.S. indexes are on track to finish the month in the green-something that has happened since May. The tech-focused Nasdaq is leading the way, up about 4.1% for the month through Friday.

Software stocks-rather than the usual high-flying AI names-were among the biggest monthly winners, thanks to a series of strong earnings reports that helped reverse some of the gloom that has loomed over the sector this year.

But the S&P 500's standout performer was Moderna, which is up 152% month-to-date through Friday, after news this month that an experimental mRNA vaccine co-developed with Merck succeeded in preventing cancer from coming back or spreading in a study of high-risk melanoma patients.
